_readme: Generated by data/scripts/star-catalogue.py. Do not edit by hand. Stars brighter than magLimit, plus every star any constellation figure references regardless of magnitude, so no line can reference a star that was filtered out. Each row is positional -- see `columns`. raHours is right ascension in hours (0-24), decDegrees is declination in degrees. Regenerate rather than patch.
attribution: HYG Database v4.4 (D. Nash / astronexus), CC BY-SA 4.0. Constellation figures: Stellarium modern_iau skyculture, CC BY-SA 4.0. Verified against Hipparcos-2 (van Leeuwen 2007, VizieR I/311).
